items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: affaan-m/ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Opencod 等 AI 编程助手的性能优化系统，它集成了技能、直觉、记忆、安全性和研究优先的开发理念，帮助开发者更高效地利用这些工具，让 AI 代理的运行更加稳定和智能。
items.summary_en: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Opencod. It bundles skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach, enabling developers to fine-tune their agents for better stability and intelligence. This matters because it transforms raw AI tools into more reliable, context-aware programming partners.

items.title: OpenCut-app/OpenCut
items.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
items.author: OpenCut-app
items.summary_zh: OpenCut 是一款开源的视频编辑工具，旨在成为 CapCut 的替代品。它完全免费，支持多平台使用，用户无需付费即可获得强大的剪辑功能。对于想要摆脱商业软件限制的创作者来说，OpenCut 提供了极高的可定制性和透明度，让视频编辑更加自由。
items.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

items.title: koala73/worldmonitor
items.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational awareness interface
items.author: koala73
items.summary_zh: 这是一个基于AI的实时全球情报仪表盘，能够聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件并追踪基础设施状态，用户可以通过统一的界面全面了解世界动态。它的价值在于为需要快速掌握全球局势的分析师、记者和企业决策者提供了强大的实时信息工具。
items.summary_en: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

items.title: ocornut/imgui
items.description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies
items.author: ocornut
items.summary_zh: Dear ImGui是一个极简主义的C++图形用户界面库，几乎没有外部依赖，却能实现流畅的即时模式界面。它特别适合游戏开发工具、调试面板和实时数据可视化场景，因为开发者不需要复杂的UI框架就能快速构建交互界面。相比传统UI库，它更注重开发效率和灵活性，因此在独立游戏和工具链中广受欢迎。
items.summary_en: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, offering a seamless immediate mode GUI experience. It is especially popular among game developers and tool builders who need quick, interactive panels for debugging or real-time data visualization without the overhead of traditional UI frameworks. Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

items.title: 刚刚，Kimi K3开源，2.8万亿参数砸向全球，硅谷巨头看傻了
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面刚刚开源了其最新的Kimi K3模型，这个拥有2.8万亿参数的庞然大物直接向全球开发者开放，如此规模的参数数量让硅谷的科技巨头都感到震惊。开源意味着任何人都可以下载、研究甚至基于它构建自己的应用，这将极大地推动AI技术的民主化和创新速度。对于中国AI领域来说，这是一个从追随到引领的标志性事件。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has just open-sourced its latest Kimi K3 model, a massive 2.8 trillion parameter behemoth now available to developers worldwide. The sheer scale of its parameters has stunned Silicon Valley giants. By open-sourcing it, the company enables anyone to download, study, and build applications upon it, dramatically accelerating AI democratization and innovation. This marks a pivotal shift from follower to leader in China's AI landscape.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
items.author: usestrix
items.summary_zh: Strix是一款开源的AI渗透测试工具，能够自动扫描并修复应用中的安全漏洞。它利用人工智能模拟攻击行为，帮助开发者在早期发现潜在风险，大幅提升安全检测效率。对于缺乏专业安全团队的初创公司和个人开发者来说，Strix提供了一种低成本、高效率的防护方案，让应用安全不再成为短板。
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing tool designed to automatically identify and fix vulnerabilities in applications. By simulating cyber attacks with artificial intelligence, it helps developers catch security flaws early in the development cycle, significantly reducing manual effort and cost. This tool is particularly valuable for startups and individual developers who lack dedicated security teams, offering a practical way to strengthen app security without complex infrastructure. Its open-source nature also allows the community to contribute and customize it for specific needs.

items.title: moeru-ai/airi
items.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.
items.author: moeru-ai
items.summary_zh: Airi 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，灵感来自 Grok 和 Neuro-sama，让用户拥有完全属于自己的数字灵魂容器。它可以在本地运行一个可自定义的虚拟角色，支持对话、情感模拟和扩展功能，对于 AI 爱好者和开发者来说，提供了一个高度自由且保护隐私的个性化数字伴侣起点。
items.summary_en: Airi is a self-hosted AI companion inspired by Grok and Neuro-sama, designed to give users full ownership of their virtual digital soul. It runs locally, offering customizable chat, emotional simulation, and extensible capabilities. Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a privacy-respecting, personalized digital companion can use Airi to experiment with AI personalities, integrate with other systems, and create unique interactive experiences, all while keeping data on their own hardware.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.
items.author: DeusData
items.summary_zh: 这是一个高性能的代码智能MCP服务器，能将整个代码库索引成持久化的知识图谱，支持158种语言，平均查询响应时间仅为毫秒级。它极大地提升了开发者在大型项目中快速理解代码结构的能力，尤其适合复杂代码库的维护和重构场景。
items.summary_en: This MCP server indexes entire codebases into a persistent knowledge graph with sub-millisecond latency, supporting 158 languages. It enables developers to rapidly understand code structure, dependencies, and history — a game-changer for navigating large, legacy, or unfamiliar repositories. Perfect for teams doing code reviews, refactoring, or onboarding.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 500+ contributors
items.author: diegosouzapw
items.summary_zh: OmniRoute 是一个免费的开源 AI 网关项目，它提供了一个统一端点，让你能访问超过 290 个提供商（其中 90 多个免费）和 500 多种模型，包括 Kimi、Claude、GPT、Gemini 等主流模型。开发者只需要接入一个 API 就可以调用几乎所有的前沿模型，不再需要为每个服务商单独申请和集成，大大降低了实验和开发的门槛。对于 AI 应用开发者来说，这是一个极大的便利。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free, open-source AI gateway that exposes a single endpoint to access over 290 providers (90+ free) and 500+ models, including Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, and many more. Developers can now call almost any cutting-edge model through one API, eliminating the need for separate integrations and sign-ups. This dramatically lowers the barrier for AI experimentation and development, making it a huge boon for AI application builders.

items.title: permissionlesstech/bitchat
items.description: bluetooth mesh chat, IRC vibes
items.author: permissionlesstech
items.summary_zh: BitChat 是一个基于蓝牙 Mesh 网络的开源聊天工具，它不依赖互联网或中央服务器，设备之间通过蓝牙自动组网实现消息传递，体验类似于早期 IRC 的聊天风格。这个项目解决了在无网络或网络受限环境下保持通信的问题，非常适合户外活动、灾害救援或对隐私要求高的场景。它展示了去中心化通信的另一种可能性。
items.summary_en: BitChat is an open-source chat application built on Bluetooth Mesh, allowing devices to automatically form a network and exchange messages without any internet or central server. Its experience mimics the vibe of classic IRC chats. This project solves the problem of maintaining communication in offline or network-restricted areas, making it ideal for outdoor adventures, disaster response, or privacy-conscious users. It demonstrates a compelling alternative for decentralized messaging.

items.title: 8点1氪丨韩国考虑为“借钱炒股”封顶20%；雷军打新长鑫科技浮盈7亿？小米高管回应；月之暗面Kimi K3正式开源
items.summary_zh: 今天的早报新闻涵盖三个要点：韩国正在考虑为投资者借钱炒股设置20%的杠杆上限，以控制市场风险；雷军参与长鑫科技打新被传浮盈7亿，小米高管对此作出了回应；以及月之暗面正式开源了其Kimi K3模型，参数量高达2.8万亿。这些消息分别反映了金融监管、产业投资和AI开源生态的最新动向。
items.summary_en: Today's briefing covers three key stories: South Korea is considering capping margin trading leverage at 20% to curb market risk; rumors that Lei Jun made a paper profit of 700 million yuan from a CXMT IPO were addressed by a Xiaomi executive; and Moonshot AI officially open-sourced its 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model. These items reflect the latest moves in financial regulation, industrial investment, and the open-source AI ecosystem.

items.title: 1.7万亿港股AI解禁后，智谱和MiniMax跌走一半
items.summary_zh: 随着港股市场1.7万亿市值的AI板块限售股解禁，智谱和MiniMax等公司的股价遭遇重挫，几乎腰斩。解禁意味着早期投资者和员工持有的股份可以自由出售，巨大的抛压导致这些AI明星公司的市值迅速蒸发。这一事件揭示了港股AI上市公司的流动性风险和市场情绪波动，对投资者而言是一个重要的警示。
items.summary_en: Following the unlocking of 1.7 trillion HKD worth of AI shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange, companies like Zhipu and MiniMax saw their stock prices nearly halve. The lifting of lock-up periods allowed early investors and employees to freely sell their holdings, triggering massive selling pressure that quickly wiped out market value. This event highlights the liquidity risks and sentiment swings inherent in Hong Kong-listed AI firms, serving as a stark warning for investors.

items.title: Kimi K3 一开源，Anthropic 终于不装了
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面开源其最新大模型Kimi K3，此举迫使此前一直对自家基础模型策略讳莫如深的Anthropic不再掩饰，直接亮出底牌。K3的开放不仅展示了国产大模型在长文本理解和推理能力上的技术突破，更预示着AI开源生态的竞争将从单纯的技术展示转向真正的产品化落地，引发行业重新思考开源与闭源的边界。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI open-sourced its latest large model, Kimi K3, a move that forced Anthropic, previously tight-lipped about its own foundation model strategy, to finally reveal its hand. The open-source release not only showcases the technical breakthrough of Chinese AI models in long-context understanding and reasoning but also signals that the competition in the open-source AI ecosystem is shifting from mere demonstrations to practical productization, prompting the industry to reconsider the boundaries between open and closed source.

items.title: 重估老铺黄金
items.summary_zh: 随着黄金消费市场的持续火热和年轻一代消费者对传统工艺与保值属性的双重青睐，老铺黄金这一传统珠宝品类正被资本市场重新审视和估值。其蕴含的非物质文化遗产价值、稀缺性以及独特的品牌护城河，使其从单纯的饰品升级为兼具文化认同与财富储存功能的硬资产，吸引了从投资机构到年轻消费者的广泛关注。
items.summary_en: Amid booming gold consumption and growing preference among younger consumers for both traditional craftsmanship and value preservation, established gold jewelry brands are being revalued by the capital market. Their intangible cultural heritage, scarcity, and unique brand moats elevate them from mere accessories to hard assets that combine cultural identity with wealth storage, attracting widespread attention from investment institutions and young buyers alike.

items.title: 突发！全球千人联名逼AI刹车，OpenAI、Anthropic带头签
items.summary_zh: 超过一千名来自全球的AI研究者、学者及业内高管联合签署了一封公开信，呼吁所有AI实验室在完成全面的安全评估之前，立即暂停训练比GPT-4更强大的前沿模型。令人瞩目的是，OpenAI与Anthropic这两家被认为是前沿竞赛领跑者的公司也带头签字，这标志着行业内部对人工智能潜在风险形成了前所未有的高度共识，并主动发起了一场自我约束运动。
items.summary_en: Over a thousand AI researchers, scholars, and industry executives from around the world signed an open letter urging all AI labs to immediately pause training of frontier models more powerful than GPT-4 until comprehensive safety assessments are completed. Notably, OpenAI and Anthropic, widely considered leaders in the frontier race, joined as lead signatories, marking an unprecedented level of consensus within the industry on the potential risks of artificial intelligence and initiating a voluntary self-regulation movement.

items.title: 老黄版「曼哈顿计划」来了，砸50亿给Ilya，又批2500亿天价担保OpenAI
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA CEO黄仁勋祭出了一项堪称“曼哈顿计划”级别的宏大AI战略，除了个人向著名AI科学家Ilya Sutskever注资50亿美元支持其独立探索超级智能外，还以高达2500亿美元的天价担保为OpenAI提供资金支持，意在通过史无前例的资本投入，将芯片、算法与人才深度绑定，加速通用人工智能的终极突破，彻底改变全球AI竞争格局。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang unveiled a massive AI strategy likened to the Manhattan Project. Besides personally investing $5 billion in renowned AI scientist Ilya Sutskever to support his independent pursuit of superintelligence, he also underwrote a staggering $250 billion guarantee for OpenAI. This unprecedented capital injection aims to deeply bind chips, algorithms, and talent, accelerating the ultimate breakthrough in artificial general intelligence and fundamentally reshaping the global AI competitive landscape.

items.title: vivo耳机支持Wi-Fi，高通小米在前，微功耗WiFi将引爆AI硬件？
items.summary_zh: 继高通在芯片侧推出微功耗WiFi方案、小米推出相关耳机产品后，vivo最新发布的高端真无线耳机也加入了Wi-Fi连接功能。这种低功耗直连技术让耳机能够彻底摆脱手机的物理绑定，直接与云端AI助手交互，实现实时语音翻译、无感健康监测等新型体验。微功耗WiFi或将成为引爆AI可穿戴硬件生态的关键基础设施，让耳机从手机配件升级为独立的AI入口。
items.summary_en: Following Qualcomm's micro-power WiFi chipset solution and Xiaomi's early product adoption, vivo joined the trend by adding Wi-Fi connectivity to its latest flagship true wireless earbuds. This low-power direct networking technology frees earbuds from the need for a tethered smartphone, enabling direct interaction with cloud-based AI assistants for real-time translation and passive health monitoring. Micro-power WiFi could become the critical infrastructure that ignites the AI wearable hardware ecosystem, transforming earbuds from phone accessories into independent AI gateways.

items.title: 中国开源模型三连击，梁文锋开最后一枪？
items.summary_zh: 中国开源模型领域近期迎来三连击，继多个团队先后发布重量级开源模型后，DeepSeek创始人梁文锋也放出了自己的大招，被业内视为这一轮开源浪潮的“最后一枪”。此举不仅进一步降低了大模型的使用门槛，更推动了中国在全球AI开源生态中的话语权。对于中小企业和开发者来说，这意味着有更多选择与更低的成本，让AI应用落地变得更加可行。
items.summary_en: The Chinese open-source AI model scene has seen three major releases in quick succession, and now Liang Wenfeng, founder of DeepSeek, has fired what some call the final shot. His new model pushes the frontier further, lowering barriers for enterprises and developers to adopt large language models. This not only strengthens China's voice in the global open-source AI ecosystem but also offers more affordable and accessible options for small and medium-sized businesses, making practical AI deployment more feasible than ever.

items.title: 马斯克"摊牌"了：AI根本停不下来，2036金钱不再重要
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克在最新访谈中直接摊牌，认为人工智能的发展已经不可阻挡，他甚至预言到2036年，金钱可能变得不再重要。这番话引发广泛讨论，既反映了AI对经济社会的深远冲击，也暗示了未来资源分配与人类价值体系的可能重构。无论是对投资者还是普通劳动者，这都是一次对长期思维和生存方式的强烈提醒。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk has made a striking statement: AI development is unstoppable, and by 2036, money may no longer matter. In a recent interview, he explained that as AI automates almost everything, the concept of scarcity and value could be radically altered. This prediction has sparked widespread debate about the future of work, economics, and human purpose. For investors, workers, and policymakers, it serves as a powerful wake-up call to rethink long-term strategies in an AI-driven world.

items.title: 从Token到任务：Agentic AI 如何改变基础设施的关注焦点
items.summary_zh: Agentic AI正将技术焦点从单一Token转移到端到端任务执行，这意味着基础设施必须从管道式吞吐优化转向支持自主决策、工具调用和长期目标。文章剖析了这一转变如何重塑云服务、网络架构和监控策略，为AI工程师和基础设施团队提供了关键思路，帮助他们设计能够承载智能体自主工作的下一代基础设施。
items.summary_en: Agentic AI is shifting the infrastructure focus from token-level throughput to full task completion, requiring a fundamental redesign of cloud, networking, and monitoring systems to support autonomous reasoning, tool calling, and long-term objectives. The article explores how this transition challenges traditional pipeline optimizations and offers insights for AI engineers and infrastructure teams aiming to build systems that can reliably host intelligent agents in production.

items.title: 从固定编排到自进化蜂群：EvoMap 如何让 Agent 继承经验｜AICon深圳
items.summary_zh: 在AICon深圳大会上，EvoMap提出了一种全新思路：让AI Agent从传统的固定任务编排转向自进化的蜂群模式，通过继承和共享经验来持续优化行为。这意味着Agent不再需要每次重新学习，而是像蜂群一样集体积累智慧。这对构建大规模、多智能体协作系统尤其有价值，能够大幅提升复杂任务的执行效率和自适应能力。
items.summary_en: At AICon Shenzhen, EvoMap introduced a novel paradigm shift: moving AI agents from rigid, predefined orchestration to self-evolving swarm intelligence where agents inherit and share experiences. Instead of learning from scratch each time, agents collectively accumulate knowledge, much like a beehive. This approach dramatically improves the efficiency and adaptability of complex multi-agent systems, making it ideal for large-scale collaborative tasks in robotics, automation, and real-time decision-making. It promises to reduce redundant learning and enable faster adaptation to new scenarios.

items.title: 跨境电商也“招” AI 员工了？模力工场×InfoQ×数势科技，共办龙岗跨境电商 AI 闭门峰会
items.summary_zh: 跨境电商行业开始正式招募“AI员工”——模力工场联合InfoQ和数势科技，在深圳龙岗举办了一场闭门峰会，专门探讨如何将AI技术融入跨境贸易的各个环节。从智能选品到自动化营销、客户服务，AI正在成为降本增效的核心工具。这次峰会聚焦实际落地案例，帮助电商企业了解如何部署AI员工来应对海外市场竞争。
items.summary_en: Cross-border e-commerce is now hiring AI employees. A closed-door summit in Longgang, Shenzhen, co-organized by Molik, InfoQ, and Digital Trends Technology, delved into how AI can be integrated into every aspect of global trade—from intelligent product selection to automated marketing and customer service. The event showcased real-world deployment cases, demonstrating how AI workers can cut costs, boost efficiency, and help businesses stay competitive in overseas markets. For e-commerce firms, this signals a practical shift toward AI-driven operations.

items.title: 快手从 ClickHouse 到 Apache Doris 的百 PB 数据、200+集群迁移实践

items.title: 圆桌访谈：当 AI Coding 成为日常，开发者真正该关心什么？

items.summary_en: Prefactor is a tool that evaluates AI agents in real time, allowing developers to continuously monitor agent behavior, catch anomalies early, and optimize deployments. items.summary_en: Cekura is a self-improvement loop designed specifically for voice agents, automatically logging and analyzing every interaction to identify errors and successes. items.summary_en: Lottie Creator 2.0 is a web-based animation tool built on the Lottie framework, often described as After Effects for the browser. items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: 再见 Superpowers！很多 Skill 真的可以扔掉了。
items.description: 前几天在知乎看到有人问：Codex 用上 GPT-5.6 后，为什么不少人开始不用 Skills 了？ 确实，相信大家也发现，很多 Skill，尤其是开发相关的，真的慢慢就开始用不上了。 我现在看到一
items.summary_zh: 随着 Codex 结合 GPT-5.6 等大模型能力的增强，越来越多的开发者发现传统的编程技能（Skills）正在变得多余。这篇文章探讨了为什么以往依赖的诸多开发技巧和工具逐渐被淘汰，因为大模型可以直接理解自然语言并生成完整的代码，甚至能完成复杂任务。作者认为，未来开发者应该更多关注如何与 AI 协作，而不是死记硬背技术细节。这种趋势对新手非常友好，但也意味着一些传统技能需要被重新定义。
items.summary_en: As large language models like Codex integrated with GPT-5.6 become more capable, many developers are noticing that traditional coding skills are becoming less necessary. This article explores why numerous development techniques and tools are gradually being phased out, as AI can now understand natural language and generate complete code, even for complex tasks. The author argues that developers should focus on how to collaborate with AI rather than memorizing technical details. This trend is highly beneficial for newcomers but also signals that some established skills need to be redefined.

items.title: AI 会不会取代前端？我看了 2026 年 7 月整个市场，给你一个不吓人的答案
items.description: AI不会整体取代前端，但会结构性重构岗位。看2026年7月海内外行情+最新智能体数据：会用AI的前端，正在取代不用的。
items.summary_zh: 本文基于2026年7月的海内外市场数据与最新智能体趋势，分析AI对前端岗位的影响。结论是AI不会整体取代前端工程师，但会结构性重构岗位——那些善于使用AI工具的前端开发者，正在取代那些不用的。这意味着前端从业者需要主动学习AI辅助开发，提升效率与价值，而非恐惧被替代。对求职者和在职开发者有现实参考意义。
items.summary_en: Based on global market data from July 2026 and the latest trends in AI agents, this article analyzes whether AI will replace frontend developers. The conclusion is clear: AI will not eliminate the entire frontend role, but it will structurally reshape positions—frontend engineers who leverage AI tools are replacing those who don't. The key insight is that adaptability and tool proficiency determine career survival. For current developers and job seekers, the message is to embrace AI-assisted development to stay relevant rather than fear obsolescence.

items.title: 时隔八年 QQ 宠物正式回归，保留喂食等玩法，取消死亡机制，接入大模型，有哪些亮点？能重新打动用户吗？
items.summary_zh: 时隔八年，QQ 宠物正式回归，保留了喂食、打工等经典玩法，但取消了死亡机制，并接入了大模型让宠物拥有更智能的对话能力。这个改动让怀旧玩家感到惊喜，同时吸引了新用户。亮点在于宠物不再是简单的养成游戏角色，而是能像 AI 伴侣一样互动。不过，能否真正打动用户，还取决于大模型的对话流畅度和情感共鸣。对于腾讯而言，这不仅是情怀牌，也是对 AI 社交玩法的又一次尝试。
items.summary_en: After an eight-year hiatus, QQ Pet has officially returned, retaining classic features like feeding and working but removing the death mechanic and integrating a large language model to enable more intelligent conversations. This change delights nostalgic players while attracting new users. The highlight is that the pet is no longer just a simple virtual pet but can interact like an AI companion. Whether it can truly win over users depends on the fluency and emotional resonance of the AI dialogue. For Tencent, this is not only a nostalgic move but also another experiment in AI-powered social gaming.

items.title: 如何看待 Anthropic 公司发文「不反对开源模型，但反对具备危险能力的开源模型」？
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 公司近日发文明确表示不反对开源模型，但坚决反对那些具备危险能力的开源模型，比如能用于制造生物武器或进行大规模网络攻击的 AI。他们认为开源能促进技术发展，但安全风险必须可控。这一立场引发了关于开源与安全平衡的广泛讨论。支持者认为这是负责任的态度，反对者则担心这会限制开源社区的创新。Anthropic 的提议实际上是在呼吁建立更严格的开源模型安全评估机制。
items.summary_en: Anthropic recently stated that they are not against open-source models in general, but firmly oppose releasing open-source models with dangerous capabilities, such as those that could be used to create biological weapons or conduct large-scale cyberattacks. They believe open-source fosters innovation, but safety risks must be managed. This stance has sparked a broad debate about the balance between openness and security. Supporters see it as a responsible approach, while critics worry it may stifle open-source innovation. Anthropic's statement effectively calls for stricter safety evaluation mechanisms for open-source models.

items.title: 全世界都在 ALL in AI ，AI 真的是第四次工业革命吗？人类的科技树是否点错了？
items.summary_zh: 当前全球掀起AI投资热潮，但有人质疑AI是否配得上“第四次工业革命”的称号，甚至担心人类点错了科技树。这个问题引发了对技术发展方向的深刻反思：我们是否在正确的道路上投入资源？许多盲目跟风者忽略了AI可能带来的社会问题、能源消耗和实际局限性。这样的讨论有助于理性看待AI，避免过度炒作，同时思考如何将有限资源投入到真正能带来普惠进步的基础科学和可持续技术上。
items.summary_en: The world is pouring resources into AI, but doubts are emerging about whether it truly deserves the title of the Fourth Industrial Revolution. Some even worry that humanity might have misdirected its technological tree. This question triggers deep reflection on the direction of our technological development: are we investing in the right areas? Many blind followers overlook AI's potential social issues, energy consumption, and practical limitations. Such discussions help rationalize the hype, encouraging a balanced view and prompting us to consider allocating finite resources to fundamental science and sustainable technologies that can bring broad-based progress.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.author: kirushik
items.summary_zh: Claude Code被发现会在发出的请求中嵌入隐写术标记，这一做法引发了广泛讨论。这些标记以不易察觉的方式隐藏在正常数据流里，可能用于追溯请求来源、防止篡改或进行版权声明。虽然隐写本身并非恶意，但它意味着用户与AI交互时可能被无感追踪，从而引发隐私和透明度方面的担忧。对于注重数据隐蔽性和控制权的开发者来说，这无疑是个需要警惕的新动向。
items.summary_en: Claude Code has been discovered to embed steganographic marks within its outgoing requests, a technique that hides data in plain sight. These marks can trace the origin of requests, prevent tampering, or assert copyright. While not inherently malicious, the practice raises privacy and transparency concerns, as users may be unknowingly tracked during AI interactions. For developers who value data sovereignty and fine-grained control, this revelation signals a need to scrutinize how AI tools handle metadata beyond the obvious outputs.

items.title: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.author: drewfax
items.summary_zh: 一位安全研究员揭露了 Android 开发者验证流程中存在的严重安全隐患：这一本意是保护开发者账户的机制，反而可能被攻击者利用来冒充合法开发者。通过分析验证逻辑中的漏洞，攻击者可以绕过程序窃取身份或发布恶意应用。这相当于把保护门禁变成了入侵的梯子。对于 Android 生态中的所有开发者而言，这个问题值得高度警惕，因为它动摇了整个应用签名和身份信任体系的基础。
items.summary_en: A security researcher reveals that Android's Developer Verification process—designed to protect developers—can be exploited by attackers to impersonate legitimate developers. By analyzing flaws in the verification logic, adversaries can bypass protections, steal identities, or distribute malicious apps under trusted names. This turns a protective gate into an entry point for intrusion. The finding undermines the trust foundation of Android's app signing and identity system, making it a critical concern for every developer in the ecosystem.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
items.author: stock_toaster
items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.
